article_title: The rise of 'housefishing' - when does using AI go from enhancing to misleading?

tasks.prompt: What central question does the report examine?
options: Whether AI-enhanced property photos help buyers visualise potential or mislead them
Whether online property sites should stop showing photographs
Why estate agents no longer use wide-angle lenses
How buyers can purchase homes without visiting them
tasks.correct_answer: Whether AI-enhanced property photos help buyers visualise potential or mislead them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את הגבול בין שיפור לגיטימי של תמונות נכס לבין הטעיית קונים אפשריים.

tasks.prompt: What surprised Olivia Nicole when she viewed the house in person?
options: The house had already been sold
The agent had added an extra bedroom
The rooms, decor and some structural features differed from the listing images
The property was in a different part of London
tasks.correct_answer: The rooms, decor and some structural features differed from the listing images
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אוליביה גילתה שהחדרים קטנים יותר, העיצוב שונה וגם פרטים מבניים לא תאמו לתמונות.

tasks.prompt: What does “housefishing” mean in the report?
options: Searching for a home only near water
Using misleadingly enhanced images to make a property look better than it is
Buying a house through a social-media channel
Removing furniture before an in-person viewing
tasks.correct_answer: Using misleadingly enhanced images to make a property look better than it is
tasks.explanation_hebrew: housefishing הוא כינוי לשימוש בתמונות משופרות שמציגות נכס באופן מטעה ביחס למציאות.

tasks.prompt: According to the survey cited, what share of recent UK homebuyers had viewed a property with flattering digital enhancements?
options: One in fifty
One in ten
One in five
One in two
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בסקר של 906 רוכשי בתים בבריטניה, אחד מכל חמישה דיווח שראה נכס שתמונותיו שופרו דיגיטלית.

tasks.prompt: Which use of AI does Jack Bushrod regard as acceptable?
options: Removing a structural pillar
Adding a window that does not exist
Hiding cracks in floor tiles
Adding furniture to an empty room to show its potential
tasks.correct_answer: Adding furniture to an empty room to show its potential
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בושרוד מקבל שינויים כמו הוספת רהיטים לחדר ריק או סידור עומס, כל עוד אינם מטעים.

tasks.prompt: What does “jump on the bandwagon” suggest about estate agents?
options: They may copy a growing trend because others are doing it
They will stop advertising homes online
They will physically travel together to viewings
They may return to film cameras
tasks.correct_answer: They may copy a growing trend because others are doing it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי jump on the bandwagon מתאר הצטרפות למגמה פופולרית משום שאחרים כבר אימצו אותה.

tasks.prompt: Why did Olivia feel the unclear use of AI had wasted her time?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין הפער בתמונות, ההגעה לצפייה והמחיר האישי ששילמה.
expected_points: The listing did not clearly disclose that its images were AI-enhanced
The real rooms and features differed substantially from the pictures
She took several hours off work to attend the viewing
She later had to make up those working hours

tasks.prompt: Summarise the distinction the report draws between acceptable enhancement and misleading alteration.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג דוגמאות משני צדי הגבול ואת חשיבות הסימון הברור.
expected_points: Basic improvements or virtual furnishing can help people imagine a property's potential
Decluttering a room can be acceptable
Adding or removing structural features can misrepresent the property
Hiding stains or cracks may conceal relevant defects
Trading Standards says the use of AI should be indicated

tasks.prompt: Why might clear labels reduce the harm caused by AI-enhanced property photos?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד גילוי נאות משפיע על ציפיות הקונה ועל יכולתו לפרש את התמונות.
expected_points: Labels alert buyers that an image may not show the current reality
Buyers can distinguish visualisation from actual property features
Clear expectations can reduce surprise and wasted viewings
Prominent disclosure may discourage agents from making misleading edits

tasks.prompt: Write a short policy recommendation for estate agents using AI in property listings, supported by evidence from the report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע כלל ברור, להבחין בין הדמיה לשינוי מבני ולהסתמך על דוגמה מהכתבה.
expected_points: Require prominent labels on every AI-enhanced image and in the listing's key features
Permit limited uses such as virtual furniture or decluttering
Ban edits that add, remove or hide structural features or defects
Explain that undisclosed changes can waste buyers' time or potentially mislead consumers
Reference Olivia's experience, Trading Standards guidance or Howards's new labelling policy
